summary_en: FY5/27 dividend: ¥82/share (¥72 ordinary + ¥10 anniversary special). Mid-term ¥30/share (¥25 ordinary + ¥5 special); year-end ¥52/share (¥47 ordinary + ¥5 special). Marks 20th anniversary from May 2007 founding. Mid-term distribution subject to board; year-end subject to annual shareholder meeting.
title_en: Notice Regarding Implementation of 20th Anniversary Commemorative Dividend
translation_en_brief: E·J Holdings announced on 14 July 2026 that it will pay a special anniversary dividend in FY5/27 (year ending 31 May 2027) to commemorate its 20th anniversary of establishment (31 May 2007). The full-year dividend is set at ¥82 per share, comprising ¥72 in ordinary dividend and ¥10 in anniversary special dividend. This breaks down as ¥30/share at mid-term (¥25 ordinary + ¥5 special) and ¥52/share at year-end (¥47 ordinary + ¥5 special). The mid-term distribution will be approved by the board of directors; the year-end distribution will be submitted to the 20th annual shareholder meeting. The company frames the special component as a token of gratitude to shareholders and other stakeholders for their support over the past two decades.
